title: Creator Review
description: A handheld creator review designed to feel useful rather than scripted.

source.note: YAPPY-owned rewrite of timing, reference, and A/B workflow concepts; no source code or proprietary provider client imported.

defaults.shot_plan: one establishing shot followed by a motivated close-up

template:
Generate an authentic creator-review video. @Image1 is the product. {{subject_reference_instruction}}

The creator is in {{setting}}, wearing {{wardrobe}}, filmed vertically with a phone-like handheld camera, mild micro-shake, natural lens distortion, and practical ambient light. The performance is {{tone}}, specific, and conversational.

TIMELINE:
00:00–00:01 — silent pattern interrupt: the creator brings the product into frame or reveals a meaningful detail.
00:01–{{speech_end}} — exact dialogue: "{{dialogue}}" The creator demonstrates {{product_action}} while speaking.
{{closing_start}}–{{duration_timestamp}} — silent close on the product and a believable final reaction.

Keep the same face, body proportions, product geometry, labels, and wardrobe across the full clip. No floating interface, fake captions, unsupported medical or financial claims, or aggressive sales acting. {{audio_reference_instruction}}
